items.title: UK referendum
items.text: UK valid-vote totals: Leave 17,410,742; Remain 16,141,241. Leave share is 51.89%, calculated from those official totals. London is a national institutional locator, not the result announcement site.

items.title: Article 50 notification
items.text: The UK formally notified the European Council of its intention to leave on 29 March 2017.
items.source: Council of the EU; Orbis summary

items.title: UK departure takes effect
items.text: Departure occurred at midnight CET on 31 January 2020; the withdrawal agreement entered into force on 1 February.
items.source: Council of the EU; Orbis summary

items.title: Transition ends
items.text: The withdrawal agreement transition period ran to 31 December 2020.
items.source: Council of the EU; Orbis summary
